actinoids.heading: Actinoid Series (5f Series)
actinoids.p1: Elements in which the last electron enters the 5f subshell are termed 5f-block elements or actinoids. Located in the 7th period of the periodic table.
actinoids.p2: Placed right after Actinium Ac-89 in Group 3 (III B), comprising 14 elements from Thorium (Th-90) to Lawrencium (Lr-103). Symbolized as An.
features: Energy Equivalence: Energy gap between 5f, 6d and 7s subshells is extremely small, facilitating wide variability in oxidation states (+3 to +7).
Complete Radioactivity: Every single element in this series is radioactive.

Experimental Challenge (Half-Life): While Thorium and Uranium have long half-lives (billions of years), later transuranics have very short half-lives (days, hours, down to 3 minutes), creating extreme experimental difficulties.
actinoids.transuranic: Transuranic Elements: All elements beyond Uranium (Z = 92), from 93 (Np) to 103 (Lr) and beyond, are artificially synthesized via nuclear reactions. They are synthetic (man-made), radioactive, and unstable heavy elements.

k2cr2o7.heading: Potassium Dichromate (K₂Cr₂O₇)
k2cr2o7.r2: (2) Reaction with H₂SO₄: Dilute yields 2CrO₃ + 2KHSO₄ + H₂O; Concentrated yields 2K₂SO₄ + 2Cr₂(SO₄)₃ + 8H₂O + 3O₂ (green colour from chromic sulphate)
k2cr2o7.r3: (3) Carbon Reduction (with steam): K₂Cr₂O₇ + H₂O + 3C --Δ--> Cr₂O₃ + 2KOH + 3CO
k2cr2o7.r4: (4) Reaction with H₂O₂: K₂Cr₂O₇ + H₂SO₄ + 4H₂O₂ → 2CrO₅ + K₂SO₄ + 5H₂O (deep blue ethereal layer of chromium pentoxide CrO₅)

structures.heading: Structures & Properties of CrO₄²⁻ and Cr₂O₇²⁻
structures.cro4: Chromate Ion (CrO₄²⁻): Cr⁶⁺ → 3d⁰, n = 0, diamagnetic, yellow color, all four Cr—O bonds are equivalent due to resonance, hybridization sd³, tetrahedral geometry.
structures.cr2o7: Dichromate Ion (Cr₂O₇²⁻): Cr⁶⁺ → 3d⁰, n = 0, diamagnetic, orange-red color, two tetrahedra sharing one oxygen atom at an angle of 126° (Cr—O—Cr), terminal Cr—O = 163 pm, bridging Cr—O = 179 pm, hybridization sd³ (each Cr), tetrahedral at each Cr.
